newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK OTE'S INVESTMENT PLAN BEHIND SCHEDULE-UNION.
newsitem.headline: GREEK OTE'S INVESTMENT PLAN BEHIND SCHEDULE-UNION.

text.p: The investment programme of Greek state telecom OTE is running behind schedule, adversely affecting revenues, OTE's main union (OME-OTE), said in a statement.
OTE's absorption rate of funds to implement planned materials procurement was about 30 percent during 1994-96, it said.

The digitalisation of Greece's phone network ought to be 55.2 percent on the basis of OTE's business plan but will reach 48.1 percent when the digitalisation rate elsewhere in Europe will range from 70 to 100 percent, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
